title: A Deal with Medusa
summary: In the Jia Ma capital, Hai Bodong fights off two Misty Cloud Sect Dou Huangs who attack him. At the academy, Xiao Yu visits Xiao Yan, and he tells her he will go back to the Jia Ma Empire to settle things with the Misty Cloud Sect. Su Qian lets Xiao Li build a force in the Black-Corner Region that is friendly to the academy, and Xiao Yan tells him the female Dou Zong is Queen Medusa. Xiao Yan finds Medusa, who still can't kill him because of the Heaven Swallowing Python inside her, and offers to refine the sixth-tier Soul Recovery Pill to free her if she guards and helps him for a year; he names her Cai Lin. Yun Shan absorbs the two elders who failed against Hai Bodong, and Xiao Yan practises the Open Mountain Seal.
